submission.justification: Absorber-F1 is recommended because it achieves the best energy resolution at 100 GeV while meeting all hard constraints. F1 has a residual dose rate of 12 μSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown, which is well below the 20 μSv/h limit required for hands-on maintenance. Absorber-F2 is eliminated due to its excessive dose rate of 85 μSv/h. While Absorber-F3 also meets all constraints with an even lower dose rate (6 μSv/h), the analysis clearly identifies F1 as providing superior energy resolution performance. The 4.7 mm plate thickness represents an optimal balance for electromagnetic shower sampling in this energy regime.
